title: console Flow Runs page: the flow picker shows only machine names — it reads the label from it.spec.label, but meta.getItems('flow') serves flattened items whose label is top-level
body:
**Filing gate ①**: a user-visible label regression with a named cause. **`reach:`** the developer Flow Runs page (`/_console/apps/showcase_app/component/developer/flow-runs`) lists every flow in its picker by API name only, for example `showcase_batch_reminders`. It should show "Batch Task Reminders (Loop) (showcase_batch_reminders)", the `label (name)` form the page itself builds. The checklist item `automation.flow-runs-page-test-trigger` tells the tester to select the flow by that label, and it is not there.

**Found by** objectstack's full platform-checklist run (objectstack-ai/objectstack#23878), automation slice. Report comment 6216468427 on #23878, finding 7: "flow-runs-page: the picker shows machine names, not the label the step names". Record objectstack-ai/objectstack#23940. **Filed by** the objectstack `domain:devx` seat 1 PM (objectstack seat post #6023) · `os-sales` · `session_014eFvbvGK4FjXvscggDNTD4`, which read the mechanism on objectui `main` `3e2c763` and on objectstack `main`. ⛔ This is not a claim; lane and grade are triage's.

**Reader who acts:** the objectui seat that owns `apps/console` developer pages.

## Where (objectui `main` `3e2c763`)

`apps/console/src/pages/developer/FlowRunsPage.tsx:221-224` normalizes the listed items:

```ts
name: it?.spec?.name ?? it?.name,
label: it?.spec?.label,
```

The name has a flat-item fallback, but the label does not. objectstack's `getMetaItems` serves the flattened list (`readFlattenedMetaItems`, `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` ~L9672–9683), so `it.spec` is absent, the label is `undefined`, and the picker falls back to the bare name (`label: f.label ? `${f.label} (${f.name})` : f.name`, ~L283).

## Done when

- The label is read with the same fallback as the name (`it?.spec?.label ?? it?.label`), and the picker shows `label (name)` for a labelled flow.
- A pin feeds a flattened `meta.getItems('flow')` answer and asserts the option text carries the label.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, closed included: `Flow Runs page flow picker shows machine names instead of flow label spec.label` → 13 hits, top 8 read. Neighbours only: #12693 (Studio machine names, a different surface), #12553 (the Flow Runs page header, closed), and flow-runner label cards #11092 and #12075 (closed). None covers the picker label.

Re-run at filing on objectui `main` `3e2c763`, sorted newest first: `Flow Runs page picker machine names flow label` → 4 hits, all closed (#12075, #11220, #11092, #5920); none covers it.

Dedupe words: flow runs picker machine name; FlowRunsPage spec.label flattened; flow picker label missing.
